title: Meridian threshold
text: Meridian Capital sample CSA, paragraph 4. The Threshold for Meridian Capital is USD 1,000,000. Exposure below the Threshold does not require a delivery.

title: Meridian minimum transfer
text: Meridian Capital sample CSA, paragraph 5. The Minimum Transfer Amount is USD 250,000. A delivery smaller than the Minimum Transfer Amount is not required.

title: Apex threshold
text: Apex Financial sample CSA, paragraph 4. The Threshold for Apex Financial is USD 500,000. The Minimum Transfer Amount is USD 100,000.

title: Apex eligible collateral
text: Apex Financial sample CSA, eligible collateral. USD cash and corporate bonds may be posted. Corporate bonds take the haircut from our stage 1 schedule before they count as coverage.

title: Harbor Lane threshold
text: Harbor Lane sample CSA, paragraph 4. The Threshold is USD 0. The Minimum Transfer Amount is USD 50,000. Any positive net exposure above the Minimum Transfer Amount is called.

title: Stage 1 haircut note
text: Stage 1 haircut schedule used by the calculator, not the full BCBS table. Cash haircut is 0 percent. Government bond haircut is 1 percent. Corporate bond haircut is 8 percent. Equity haircut is 15 percent.
